_what: What leaves the person's computer or account for each kind of model route in src/model-routes.json, as DATA a screen, a privacy page and a test all read (src/egress-disclosure.mjs). One row per route kind: `leaves` is whether the words of the ask go beyond this computer or the person's own account, `to` says where in plain words, `needs_opt_in` whether a person's choice is required first. A route kind with no row is a failing test, so a new route cannot ship without saying where it sends.

kinds.to: A model running on the person's own computer.
The AI subscriptions the person already pays for, through the MCP tools they call back with.
The AI that is calling Trillion through MCP, on the person's own subscription.
The service the person picked for their AIs' work, billed by the word to their key.
The other members of the group the work is shared with.
A rule in Trillion's own data decides; no model is asked.
